title: Heavenly Fate Returns
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought today's ceremony would end with Chen Ji's victory, a trembling voice suddenly rang out from the depths of the crowd—'Brother!' That voice pierced through the chaos, striking the softest corner of Chen Ji's heart. Chen Nian, missing for years, appeared before him without any warning.

text.content: At first dawn, heavy Spiritual Energy clouds had already gathered above the imperial capital. Chen Ji stood on the Nine Dragon Terrace before the Taihe Hall of the palace, his dark cyan robe slightly swaying in the wind, his face showing no trace of fluctuation. Below the platform, ten thousand people waited with bated breath, countless gazes converging here—some expectant, some fearful, and others secretly sharpening their knives. The invitation delivered three days ago by the Demonic Path commander-in-chief now rested quietly in his sleeve. Four characters burned like a branding iron on his nerves: Old Acquaintances Reunite. Behind these four words, friend or foe?

dialogue.content: Since all of you have come, why not show yourselves?

text.content: Before the words finished, the side door of Taihe Hall burst open with a thunderous crash. Several figures emerged one after another, at the forefront being Han Lie, the first genius of Xuanwu Sect. Behind him followed more than a dozen elderly figures with profound auras, all representatives nominated by major aristocratic families. Han Lie's eyes blazed with battle intent, though a disdainful cold smile played at the corner of his mouth: 'Chen Ji, you're nothing but a lucky wretch, how dare you play tricks here?'

dialogue.content: The thirty-seven elders of my Xuanwu Sect have submitted a joint petition demanding a thorough investigation into your identity and origins. A servant disciple, by what right do you control the fate of the imperial dynasty?

text.content: Han Lie's questioning fell with a thud, sparking heated murmurs among the crowd below. Those old aristocrats who had been harboring dissatisfaction straightened their spines, seemingly catching a glimpse of hope for a reversal. From the Tianqing Sect's direction, Ling Yuan slowly opened his half-closed eyes, his gaze deep and unfathomable. And within the crowd, Su Qingyao furrowed her brows, her fingertips quietly gathering a sword intent—she knew Chen Ji never acted without preparation.

choice.prompt: Faced with Han Lie's public questioning, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Overwhelm with force, directly display bloodline resonance
choices.description: Disdainful of wasting words on ants, crush all opposition with absolute strength. Concise, brutal, yet most effective in deterring the insignificant.
choices.visible_reward: Strikes terror throughout the entire scene, no one dares to question further
choices.risk_hint: Exposing trump cards too early may invite greater covetousness

text.content: Chen Ji slightly raised his gaze, his eyes like an ancient deep well, revealing not the slightest ripple. In the next instant, a resplendent golden pillar of light erupted from his crown, instantly tearing apart the dark clouds above the imperial capital.

choices.text: Enter through speech, expose Han Lie's conspiracy
choices.description: Counter Han Lie's questions point by point, use words as blades to expose Xuanwu Sect's ambitions before all under heaven.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses all face, Xuanwu Sect's conspiracy exposed
choices.risk_hint: Verbal warfare is difficult to convince everyone

dialogue.content: Han Lie, did you know that evidence of your father's secret collusion with the Demonic Path back then is now in my hands?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, waiting for the optimal moment
choices.description: Temporarily endure and not act, let the opponent fully perform before delivering a fatal blow. Playing dumb to eat the tiger, this is the superior strategy.
choices.visible_reward: Build momentum, the effect of counterattacking later doubles
choices.risk_hint: If timing is not grasped well, may be considered cowardly

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, neither refuting nor defending. He simply stood with hands clasped behind his back, and that composed demeanor instead stirred a sense of unease in Han Lie's heart.

A golden pillar of light pierced the nine heavens. Spiritual Energy from a hundred-li radius gathered toward Chen Ji like a thousand rivers returning to the sea. Within that radiance, nine five-clawed golden dragons could be faintly seen coiling and intertwining, their dragon roars shaking the earth. Han Lie's face turned deathly pale—the legendary "True Dragon Manifestation of Heavenly Fate," a bloodline phenomenon that only a true Heavenly Fate Son could display. The countless people below the stage knelt and prostrated themselves, even those treacherous old aristocrats had no choice but to lower their heads. Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply, and the hands hidden in his sleeves had already subtly formed incantation gestures.

Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, fingers spread wide. Countless chains of law slithered like silver serpents through the void, converging from all directions to condense a radiantly glowing illusory jade seal in his palm. This was the materialization of imperial law—he would, as the Heavenly Fate Son, rewrite the rules of this world. Everyone held their breath, waiting for this new ruler's judgment. The air was thick with suffocating tension. Su Qingyao's hand pressed against her sword hilt, ready to respond to any sudden situation.

dialogue.content: Do you all know why Chen Tianming died those years ago?

text.content: This question exploded like thunder in everyone's ears. Chen Tianming—the name that once dominated the entire dynasty, now being spoken of once more. Han Lie's expression turned extremely ugly. He clearly hadn't expected Chen Ji to so directly expose this past. Ling Yuan's eyelids twitched, then quickly returned to calm. Murmurs began spreading through the crowd, countless eyes fixedly examining Chen Ji, trying to find the answer in his face.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji reveal his identity at this moment?

choices.text: Speak directly, acknowledging the Heavenly Fate Son identity
choices.description: Boldly announce that he is Chen Tianming's son, allowing all under heaven to witness the return of the Chen bloodline.
choices.visible_cost: Become the target of all attacks
choices.visible_reward: With proper justification, command all under heaven with no one daring to disobey
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming's enemies are spread across the world. Publicly revealing his identity will inevitably bring endless pursuit

dialogue.content: Correct, I am Chen Tianming's son, Chen Ji. My father's unfinished cause shall be inherited by me!

choices.description: Don't directly acknowledge, but let everyone draw their own conclusions. This preserves a retreat path while enjoying the benefits of the identity.
choices.visible_cost: Some people will still harbor doubts
choices.visible_reward: Able to advance or retreat, holding the initiative in hand
choices.risk_hint: An ambiguous attitude may cause some forces to continue观望

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He simply raised his hand and drew in the empty air. A bloodline mark unique to the Chen family emerged—that was precisely the transmission imprint Chen Tianming left for his descendants. The answer was self-evident.

choices.text: Counter-question and provoke, forcing Han Lie to choke on his own words
choices.description: Since Han Lie wants to investigate the identity, let him first provide evidence. If he cannot, it's a crime of slander.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie is caught in a dilemma, humiliated publicly
choices.risk_hint: If the other party truly has evidence, it may backfire

dialogue.content: Han Lie, you keep insisting on investigating my identity, so produce your evidence! If you cannot, you are guilty of deceiving the sovereign!

text.content: The bloodline mark slowly rotated in the air, golden light blazing. The ancient aura contained within that mark caused everyone present to feel a suffocating pressure—the accumulated power of the Chen family's ancestors through generations, genuine imperial orthodox bloodline inheritance. Han Lie's knees buckled, nearly falling to the ground. The elders behind him were even more ashen-faced. Ling Yuan finally rose to his feet, his aged voice echoing across the square: "This old man, Ling Yuan of the Tianqing Sect, is willing to serve the new sovereign." With these words, the situation was completely settled.

With Ling Yuan's submission, the countless subjects below the Nine Dragon Terrace knelt like waves. The mountain-and-sea-like chants of "Long live!" soared straight into the clouds, causing the capital's walls to tremble. Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, a gratified smile curling at her lips—this man would never disappoint her. Mo Xiansheng's phantom manifested upon the Tianji Record, his voice audible only to Chen Ji: "Twenty-nine days remaining. The contest of Heavenly Fate has entered its mid-game."

The Tianji Record's reminder poured like a basin of cold water over his heart. Chen Ji's expression remained unmoved, yet his mind raced at lightning speed. Twenty-nine days—this was his time to race against destiny. Was the Demonic Path commander "reuniting with an old friend" a blessing or a curse? Was Chen Nian safe? These thoughts flashed through his mind, yet his face remained placid as he gazed down at the subjects submitting before him. Just then, a faint yet unmistakably familiar presence wafted from the depths of the crowd.

That presence struck like a key precisely inserted into the softest lock in his heart. Chen Ji's breath halted abruptly, and his typically unruffled pupils rippled with an uncontrollable wave of emotion. He sharply turned, his gaze blazing like lightning toward the depths of the crowd—where a woman with tattered clothes but delicate features stumbled toward the Nine Dragon Terrace. Her face was streaked with tears, her lips trembling as she emitted a hoarse yet clear voice:

The capital's clamor seemed to have been abruptly muted at this moment. Countless eyes of the people fixated on the running woman. Chen Ji's form quivered almost imperceptibly—this marked his first moment of composure breaking since arriving in this world. That delicate yet haggard visage, that sobbing cry—it shattered the indifferent mask he had meticulously constructed over years. His long-lost younger sister had suddenly materialized before him.

Chen Ji drew a steadying breath, suppressing the turbulent emotions roiling within. With measured steps, he descended from the Nine Dragon Terrace, each stride seeming to press upon the collective heartstrings of those watching. The crowd instinctively parted, creating a passage as all fixated on this unfolding scene—the Heavenly Fate child, moments ago elevated on high, now transformed into an elder brother yearning to reunite with his kin. Su Qingyao discreetly brushed away the moisture gathering at the corner of her eye, her lips curving into a tender, understanding smile. Mo Xiansheng's spectral form flickered delicately, as though documenting this historic instant.

Chen Nian hurled herself into Chen Ji's embrace, her sobs ripping through the air with heart-wrenching intensity. The days imprisoned by the Holy Sect, the arduous solo flight—all crystallized into scalding tears soaking through his garments. Chen Ji gently stroked her back, his voice low and rough yet imbued with profound tenderness: "It's alright... Brother is here." In this moment, he ceased being the calculating Chen Ji, becoming simply a brother who had at last found his sister. The surrounding imperial guards silently retreated several paces, granting this bereaved pair a private sphere of space.

After an extended period, Chen Nian's weeping gradually subsided. She lifted her gaze, tear-filled eyes meeting Chen Ji's. Her voice emerged hoarse: "Brother, I overheard them saying... you're ascending the throne in the capital today?" Chen Ji gave a slight nod, reaching out to delicately wipe the tear tracks from her cheeks. Unsettled murmurs rippled through the crowd—the Heavenly Fate child actually had a younger sister? This news spread like wings taking flight. A calculating glint flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, as if plotting something. And in some hidden shadow beyond the crowd, a pair of deep, obsidian eyes quietly observed all of this.

The Tianji Record's fragment trembled within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, yet the prophetic visions of Chen Nian remained frustratingly blurred—this was the doing of her special "Heavenly Fate Key" constitution. Her presence disrupted the Tianji Record's prophecies, rendering the future ungraspable. A subtle crease formed between Chen Ji's brows, a wisp of hidden worry stirring within him. But in the next instant, he suppressed this concern. No matter what the future held—this younger sister, Chen Ji was determined to protect!
